# Vendored: omp's collab-web

- **Source:** https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi, `packages/collab-web/src`, tag `v18.18.5` (commit `1891f380b296aeda26971abd81b89ef3247eea06`). `tool-render/tools/{ask,irc,job}.tsx` are updated to v18.18.5 as upstream has them (ask takes one HTML form, `{ html }`, and shows `details.answers`, from omp 18.18.3). The other copied files are unchanged between `v18.12.6` and `v18.18.5` (`tool-render/standalone.tsx`, `lib/codec.ts` and `lib/link.ts` changed upstream and are not vendored).
- **Licence:** MIT, `LICENSE` in this folder (copied from the repository root).
- **Copied:** `components/transcript/{Transcript.tsx,Markdown.tsx,math.ts,ToolCard.tsx,transcript.css}`, `components/agents/{AgentsPanel.tsx,agents.css}`, `tool-render/` (without `element.tsx` and `standalone.tsx`), `lib/format.ts`. Not copied: `styles/tokens.css`; the app's themes set the variables collab-web reads (`src/styles/index.css`, the `.tr-root` block). `components/agents/AgentDrawer.tsx` is not copied: it reads transcripts through collab-web's guest client and draws them with collab-web's own scrolling transcript, so omp-app's Agent Hub (`src/agents/AgentHub.tsx`) draws the drawer's header, numbers and message box with these class names over the app's own list.
- **Local changes:**
  1. `components/transcript/Transcript.tsx` imports `ActiveTool` and `ConnectionPhase` from `lib/types.ts` (written here, copied from collab-web's `lib/client.ts`), because the guest client itself is not vendored.
  2. `tool-render/index.ts` no longer re-exports `./element` (the `<omp-tool-view>` web component is not used).
  3. `components/transcript/Transcript.tsx` exports `Row`, `AssistantBody` and `EntryRow`. omp-app draws these rows in its own list (`src/chat/TranscriptList.tsx`, on TanStack Virtual); collab-web's `Transcript` component and its scroll code are not used.
  4. `tool-render/ToolView.tsx` and `components/transcript/Transcript.tsx` (`ThinkingBlock`) follow `FoldContext` from `lib/fold.ts` (written here): a pane opens or folds every tool card (Alt+O) or thinking block (Alt+T) at once, and a card drawn later starts as the last request said. The thinking block's button says whether it is open (`aria-expanded`), as the tool card's does.
  5. `components/agents/AgentsPanel.tsx` shows its "Session" heading, and a row's `main` / `sub` chip, only for a main agent: omp-app's roster lists subagents only, so both would say nothing.
  6. `components/agents/agents.css`: the running dot is steady (no pulse); the drawer is a column inside its pane (`position: absolute`, at most 460 px wide) rather than fixed over the window, on an opaque background without the glass blur, and slides in over 200 ms.
  7. `components/transcript/Transcript.tsx` draws omp's `async-result` message (background jobs that finished) as omp's terminal does (`buildAsyncResultBlock` in pi-tui's `chat/transcript-render-helpers.ts`): `JobNotice`, one "Background job completed" row per job with its type, id and duration, folding out the text omp delivered to the model; collab-web drew a chip and that raw text. The helpers are in `lib/notices.ts` (written here); the rows' styles are the "background jobs" block of `components/transcript/transcript.css`.
  8. `tool-render/ToolView.tsx` shows a running tool's live output (`tv-partial`) only once that output has been there for 300 ms (`useShownAfter`): a tool that printed and ended at once flashed the box, up to its 160 px, for a frame or two, and a view following the chat's end jumped down and back up.
  9. `components/transcript/Transcript.tsx` (`CustomBody`) draws omp's other displayed messages from their details, as omp's terminal and omp-app's old UI did (#2827): an IRC message (`irc:incoming`, `irc:autoreply`, `irc:relay`, `irc:workpool`) as "Message from StressA" and the message itself, the advisor's notes, a launch's ended processes as rows ("Supervised process completed dev (exit 0)"), a tangent sent to a background job; collab-web drew each as a chip and the text omp gives the model (the `<irc>` envelope and how to answer). A kind it does not know keeps its chip and its text, without omp's tag. The helpers (`describeNotice`, `withoutWrapper`, `contentText`) are in `lib/notices.ts`; the heading's style is `.tr-note-head` in `components/transcript/transcript.css`.
  10. `components/transcript/Transcript.tsx` draws the files a person's message names (#2830) as chips under its text (`AttachedFiles`, `withoutAttached`): the paragraph omp-app writes after the text (`splitAttached` from `@omp-app/contracts`) is left out of the text, and a chip downloads its file through `ToolRenderHost.downloadAttachment` (added in `tool-render/types.ts`). The chips' styles are `.tr-files` and `.tr-file` in `components/transcript/transcript.css`, 44 px high on a phone (not where the page keeps a computer's layout at any width, `data-desk`, #2845).
  11. `components/transcript/math.ts` ends the paragraph right above an own-line `$$` or `\[` block at its opener (`paragraphAboveMath`, a block rule before the math block rule), so an equation written under its line of text is a block as it is after a blank line (#2840). collab-web left those lines in the paragraph, and a line of the equation that Markdown reads as a block start (a lone `=` under a line, `- x`) turned part of it into a heading or a list item, with the rest shown as TeX source. The test is `components/transcript/math.test.ts`.
  12. `components/transcript/Transcript.tsx` draws no stop line ("aborted" and its message) for a reply omp stopped itself (`silentAbort`, exported for `src/chat/rows.ts`): omp's own check (`isSilentAbort`, pi-tui `chat/messages.ts`), its marker text or the `SilentAbort` bit of the reply's error id. omp marks the reply so when the chat host stops a turn for a plan's review; collab-web showed "aborted __omp.silent_abort__".
  13. `components/transcript/math.ts` asks KaTeX for its drawn output with the MathML beside it (`htmlAndMathml`, KaTeX's default) where collab-web asked for MathML only: Chromium drew no frame for `\boxed` and a brace one letter wide for `\underbrace`. `katex.min.css` is loaded by omp-app (`src/main.tsx`). In `components/transcript/transcript.css`, `.tr-md .katex` opts out of the paragraphs' `pre-wrap` (the `math` rule it replaces), and a display equation's own margin gives way to `.tr-math`'s.
  14. `tool-render/tools/web-search.tsx` shows the search providers that failed before one answered (`details.failures` from omp 18.17: `label`, `reason`) as one warning line each under the result, worded `<label> failed: <reason>` (`failureLines`, drawn with `Note` in its warning tone); an entry without a text label or reason is skipped. collab-web at v18.18.5 draws none of it. The test is `tool-render/tools/web-search.test.tsx`.
  15. `components/transcript/secretPlaceholders.ts` (written here) draws omp's Hide Secrets placeholders (`$$AMOJWTSECRET_2XUBD7NWOZ1U:L$$`) as a lock and the secret's name (`.tr-secret` in `transcript.css`), registered in `Markdown.tsx` after the math extension, since marked tries the newest extension first: collab-web set them as math, the name in italics with its code as a subscript. Code spans and blocks keep them as written. The test is `components/transcript/secretPlaceholders.test.ts`.
